name: Theatertreffen Berlin 2026
description: Theatertreffen is a world-class theatre festival showcasing the very best of German-language theatre while fostering dialogue among artists and audiences. The prestigious festival selects ten outstanding productions from hundreds across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, offering a unique platform for creative performances, insightful discussions and critical reflection on the role of theatre in society. It serves as both a showcase for the stars of tomorrow and a vital space for the theatre community.
